name: G. H. Kersley
bio: George Herbert Kersley, who published five volumes of verse between 1885 and 1897 and also painted. Wilde wrote to him over nearly ten years, from 1885 to 1894, and the seven surviving letters are almost entirely invitations: come to tea, read me one of your poems, come in this evening at nine, come on Tuesday morning and see me. In the preface to his first book Kersley called Wilde 'my noted friend'.
bio_note: Whether Kersley ever went is not recorded. All seven letters: printed 251, 283, 352, 410, 420, 443, 622-3 - invitations, reproaches for not visiting, and an offer to find him work; the editors gave no dates for them.
